Wix AI Website Builder

Wix AI Website Builder creates a customizable business website from a conversational brief and keeps it editable inside the broader Wix website platform.

What is Wix AI Website Builder?

Wix AI Website Builder is designed for people who want to move from an idea to a functioning site without assembling pages manually. It can generate the initial site structure, copy and visual direction from a conversation, after which the site can be refined with Wix editing tools and connected to Wix features such as domains, payments, bookings, marketing and business management.

Best for: Small businesses, freelancers and first-time site owners who want AI-assisted setup without giving up a full visual website editor.

Main features

  • Conversational AI website generation
  • AI-generated site structure, copy and visual direction
  • Visual editing after generation
  • Responsive website hosting
  • SEO and business-management tools
  • Optional ecommerce, payments and bookings on eligible plans

Use cases

  • Launch a small-business website from a short brief
  • Create a portfolio or professional-services site
  • Generate a first draft of site copy and page structure
  • Build a site with bookings, payments or ecommerce features
  • Publish and manage an SEO-oriented business site

Who is it for?

  • small businesses
  • freelancers
  • entrepreneurs
  • creators
  • non-technical website owners

freemium subscription

Advantages

  • Combines AI generation with a mature visual website editor
  • Permanent free plan is available for testing and basic publishing
  • Large Wix ecosystem covers domains, ecommerce, bookings, marketing and APIs

Limitations

  • The free plan uses a Wix-branded domain and branding
  • Connecting a custom domain and removing Wix branding require a paid plan
  • Advanced commerce, storage and collaborator allowances depend on the selected tier

Frequently asked questions

Can I build and publish a Wix AI site without paying?

Yes. Wix offers a free plan, but the published site uses a Wix-branded URL and Wix branding. A paid plan is needed for a custom domain and other premium capabilities.

Does Wix offer a conventional no-charge Premium trial?

The pricing page advertises a 14-day money-back period for Premium plans rather than a conventional no-charge trial, so this record marks freeTrial as false.

Can developers integrate with Wix programmatically?

Yes. Wix provides developer APIs and SDKs for site and business functionality, including REST and JavaScript-based development options.
